title: Sarhad Hydel Development Organization Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Sarhad Hydel Development Organization Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1996
ACT IV OF 1996
SARHAD HYDEL DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amendment the Sarhad
Hydel Development Organization Act, 1993
[ Gazette of N.-W. F. P., Extraordinary, 28th July, 1996]
No. PA/N.-W. F.
P./Legis/96/12554, dated 28-7-1996.---The Sarhad Hydel Development Organization
(Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 24th June, 1996 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th July, 1996, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sarhad Hydel Development Organization (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

An Act to amendment the Sarhad

[ Gazette of N.-W. F. P., Extraordinary, 28th July, 1996]
No. PA/N.-W. F.
P./Legis/96/12554, dated 28-7-1996.---The Sarhad Hydel Development Organization
(Amendment) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the

4. Amendment of section 24 of N.-W.F.P. Act I of 1993.---In the
said Act, in section 24, for subsection (6) the following shall be substituted,
namely:
"(6) The Board may also
permit the organization---
(a) to join,
promote, sponsor or incorporate public limited companies; or
(b) to join,
other statutory or corporate bodies, involved in the generation, transmission
and distribution of power. ".
